episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Marissa Irvine arrives to collect her young son Milo from his first playdate, but the woman who answers the door isn't a mother she recognizes and doesn't have Milo, beginning every parent's worst nightmare.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As Detective Alcaras investigates Milo's disappearance, Marissa, with Jenny's help, works hard to raise awareness; a press conference turns ugly when questions are asked about the Irvines' past business dealings

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Alcaras turns his attention to the recent Chicago Marathon, attended by Carrie, the Irvines and a potential new suspect; a canvassing event aims to keep the case alive; Peter takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Alcaras struggles to balance work and home life and must make a difficult choice when he's tempted by an offer that goes against his morals; the police struggle to connect the mystery marathon man with Carrie and Milo.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: News from Alcaras concerning Carrie's hideout throws suspicion on all of the Irvines; Brian uncovers a betrayal from Peter, who accuses Lia of lying; a long-buried family secret threatens to tear the Irvines apart.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The Irvines struggle to adjust to their new normal, while also recovering from the fallout of their arguments; as Marissa tries to cope with past events, Jenny deals with domestic pressures of her own and uncovers some of Richie's secrets.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Years after suffering a tragedy, a chance encounter with a young Milo leads Carrie to fixate on the boy; her obsession takes a dark turn while planning the kidnapping, forcing her to ask for help when things go awry, with deadly consequences.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Reeling from the recent home invasion, Marissa tries to put the pieces together to learn the truth; as Peter comes clean, she must decide how to protect the family; Alcaras hones in on the truth before being forced to make a tough decision.
